bundle.shortDescription: Import a task backlog into GitHub Issues and Projects
bundle.longDescription: Reads a tasks.json backlog and creates the corresponding GitHub Issues, labels, Projects V2 board items, sub-issue parents and blocked-by dependencies. Idempotent: reruns recognise issues created by the Python CLI.
